evidence_summary: Contemporaneous 17 June cabinet report confirms approval of MahaAgri-AI 2025-29 and AI, generative AI and related agricultural technologies.

title: MahaAgri-AI Policy 2025–2029
evidence_excerpt: An initial allocation of ₹500 crore is proposed
evidence_summary: Official policy sets institutional governance, shared agricultural data infrastructure, pilots and scaling; executive summary states an initial ₹500 crore allocation is proposed. Not evidence of expenditure or completed systems.

title: Maharashtra announces AI Policy 2026 to boost industry, governance and public services
evidence_excerpt: at a meeting chaired by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis yesterday
evidence_summary: Article dated 30 April 2026 says cabinet declared policy yesterday, establishing 29 April event date. Policy goals include investment, jobs, skilling and a venture fund; all are targets.

publisher: Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Department, Government of Maharashtra
title: Maharashtra Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026, GR POLICY-2026/C.R.64/IT
evidence_summary: Official Marathi PDF header dates Government Resolution 06 May 2026. It adopts statewide AI policy including infrastructure, skills, startup support and responsible use. Document date takes precedence over inconsistent index metadata.
date_conflict: Official policies index labels this item 16/05/2026; PDF header reads 06 May 2026.

title: Policies & Guidelines
evidence_excerpt: Maharashtra AI Policy-2026
evidence_summary: Official listing links the AI Policy PDF but assigns 16/05/2026, conflicting with PDF header 06 May 2026. Used to preserve discrepancy and provenance, not as the event date.

title: Maharashtra clears ₹11.26 cr Sarvam AI deployment for govt departments
evidence_excerpt: a two-year outlay of ₹11.26 crore
evidence_summary: PTI reporting of Government Resolution approval describes ₹11.26 crore two-year package, Indus for roughly 2,500 users, other speech/voice services and a TB outreach pilot. Exact GR approval date is not shown; approved deployment is not verified rollout.

title: Sarvam partners with the Government of Maharashtra to deploy Indus across state departments
evidence_excerpt: Around 2,500 officials across the state will use Indus
evidence_summary: Counterparty confirms state has approved Indus deployment for around 2,500 officials and multilingual document work. Undated marketing page uses future-tense adoption; cannot establish adoption counts or service effectiveness.

title: IBM collaborates with CTE Gujarat to propel skilling in AI and emerging technologies
evidence_excerpt: India, Bengaluru, January 12, 2024
evidence_summary: Page displays Jan 11 but release dateline explicitly says January 12, 2024 and today entered into MoU. Partnership uses SkillsBuild for generative AI, cloud and technical education. Global IBM targets are not Gujarat delivery numbers.
date_conflict: Displayed publication Jan 11; release dateline and URL Jan 12; signing uses dateline with explicit caveat.

title: IBM and Government of Gujarat sign MoU to establish AI Cluster in GIFT City
evidence_excerpt: today entered a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)
evidence_summary: Dated partner release confirms signing with DST for a watsonx-based AI cluster serving financial institutions; sandbox, proof-of-concept support and training are planned.

publisher: Hindustan Times / Press Trust of India
title: Gujarat government signs MoUs with IBM, Microsoft, and NASSCOM for AI development
evidence_excerpt: Microsoft and the Department of Science and Technology signed an MoU
evidence_summary: Reports Saturday signing of distinct MoUs with IBM, Microsoft and NASSCOM. IBM cluster and Microsoft CoE are different commitments and not duplicates; NASSCOM capability support recorded within CoE ecosystem rather than split into another row.

publisher: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
title: Setting up of AI Taskforce; GR DST/DGT/e-file/24/2024/1406/E-Governance
evidence_excerpt: resolved to constitute AI Taskforce
evidence_summary: Original resolution constitutes ten-member taskforce with AI roadmap, use case prioritization, ethics, infrastructure and capacity responsibilities for one year. Internal file approval is dated 9 December; subsequent official circular identifies resolution date as 10 December 2024.

publisher: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
title: Establishment of AI Implementation Cell; circular DST/AIE/e-file/24/2026/0291/E-Governance
evidence_excerpt: Approved Date: 10-03-2026
evidence_summary: Approved-date footer 10 March 2026; establishes AI Implementation Cell headed by GIL MD. Read clauses identify taskforce resolution 10 December 2024, extension 31 December 2025, and action-plan resolution 24 July 2025. Strong official retrospective date evidence.

publisher: Rediff Money / Press Trust of India
title: Gujarat AI Centre of Excellence Launched at GIFT City - Microsoft Partnership
evidence_excerpt: Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel inaugurated an Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence
evidence_summary: PTI Ahmedabad dateline January 27 reports CM inauguration and Innovation Challenge launch. Explicitly links the centre to June 2024 Microsoft MoU; inauguration does not demonstrate scaled public-service impact.

publisher: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
title: Launch and operational modalities of AI Innovation Challenge; circular DST/AIE/e-file/24/2025/1433/E-Governance
evidence_excerpt: Approved Date: 13-02-2026
evidence_summary: 13 February 2026 approved-date footer and e-sign. Retrospectively confirms CoE launch 27 January 2025. Sets KPIs, PoC evaluation, indicative funding up to ₹7.5/10 lakh and production support up to ₹50 lakh/₹1 crore; disbursement and acceptance rules. Annexure internally dated July 19 2025, distinct from circular approval.

title: Gujarat approves action plan for Artificial Intelligence implementation in governance
evidence_excerpt: Published - July 28, 2025 03:10 am IST
evidence_summary: Reports six-pillar 2025–2030 action plan, training target of 2.5 lakh and phased implementation. Local published date July 28 03:10 IST differs from index UTC July 27; neither is the official July 24 resolution date.
